name: Emissions selection — UK default, mark-up unconfirmed and recorded as such
why: HMRC has not confirmed a UK equivalent of the EU mark-up, so the UK figure is unmarked. The distinction this pins is between a mark-up that is legislated at zero and one that is simply unknown: the warning says the schedule is unconfirmed rather than letting a bare zero read as settled. When HMRC publishes, this case is what shows the UK figure moving.

decision_trace.detail: No supplier direct emissions found in extraction output.
No supplier direct emissions at required confidence. Falling back to Annex VI default values.
Annex VI default applied: direct=46305.000 kgCO2e, indirect=7840.000 kgCO2e (SEE=2.210 tCO2e/t, source: EU 2023/1773 Art.4(3) Default Values, DG TAXUD Dec 2023)
